name: mama-budget
description: Mama lives in your browser. She reads your cart item by item and stops the waste before you pay.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n ext,api -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @mama/extension" "npm run api"
scripts.test: MAMA_SAID_FILE=/tmp/mama-said-test.json MAMA_LEDGER=demo node --test api/test/*.test.js && npm test -w @mama/extension && npm test -w @mama/chatgpt
scripts.update: git pull --rebase --autostash && npm install && npm run build:ext && echo "Built. In chrome://extensions click Reload on Mama Budget."
